title: Acme Mutual claims assistant: pattern
subtitle: What the AI part of the claims platform should be.

verdict.text: Retrieval over the claim documents and a drafted summary, with a handler reviewing every draft.

blocks.text: A workflow retrieves the claim's documents and the policy wording, and drafts a summary and a proposed settlement. A handler reviews every draft. An agent that acts on its own is ruled out: a wrong settlement promise cannot go out unread.

facts.scope: The AI part of the Acme Mutual claims platform

decisions.title: AI pattern
decisions.chosen: Retrieval and a drafted summary, handler reviews every draft
decisions.because: 30,000 claims a year are too many to read by hand, and a wrong settlement must not reach a customer unread.

assumptions: A handler reviews every draft before it reaches a customer.
open: Can Acme Mutual export 500 past claims with their outcomes for evaluation?
